articles.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

articles.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital’s Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visa’s Network
articles.snippet: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Union’s USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.

articles.title: Tether Gold Gets Clean KPMG Audit Confirming $2.2B in Physical Gold Backing
articles.snippet: KPMG counted every gold bar behind XAUT, making it Tether's second stablecoin to complete a full audit by a Big Four accounting firm.

articles.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
articles.snippet: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.
